lastCompletedStory.title: Catch ContainerAuthError in the ensure-guard and fail closed

nextStoryContext: runContainerEnsureGuard (src/commands/sidecar.ts) now imports ContainerAuthError from ../supervisor/container-auth.ts and catches it as a new branch inserted between the existing FirewallError and ContainerConfigError branches (instanceof checks, order matters only for readability here since the classes are disjoint). It mirrors the FirewallError branch exactly: writes an operator-facing stderr line, then calls writeSidecarStalledMarker(stalledMarkerPath, { reason: 'container-auth-unavailable', detail: e.stderrTail, writtenAt: new Date().toISOString() }) and returns true (abort boot, no worker dispatched, runSidecarLoopFn never invoked). The 'container-auth-unavailable' reason was already registered in sidecar-stalled.ts's SidecarStalledReason union + VALID_REASONS array by US-001 of this same PRD, so no schema change was needed here -- this story only wires the throw-to-marker path. ContainerConfigError and ToolchainMismatchError branches were left untouched (still write no marker, per their deliberate design). Test coverage: test/commands/sidecar-auth.test.ts (new file, mirrors test/commands/sidecar-firewall.test.ts's structure) covers the loop-never-entered assertion via a runSidecarLoopFn spy, the marker round-trip (reason/detail/writtenAt) via readSidecarStalledMarker, and a negative-control pair proving ContainerConfigError/ToolchainMismatchError still write no marker. file-size-budget.json's src/commands/sidecar.ts ceiling was raised 3453->3471 (this story's doc-comment update + new catch branch); _ref prepended with a dated US-004/CAM-396 note per the ratchet-raise convention. This closes out the fail-closed wiring epic that started with US-001 (marker reason registration) through US-003 (ensure-container.ts throws ContainerAuthError) to this story (sidecar boot-guard catches and fails closed); check prd.json for whether CAM-241 (cross-repo harness support) or another follow-up story remains in this PRD before assuming the epic is fully done.
